purpose: Close post-WP02 source gaps before BSD-WP04 target selection.

sources.citation: Chan-Ho Kim, On the p-converse to a theorem of Gross-Zagier and Kolyvagin, arXiv:2109.12344, revision dated 2026-03-22
sources.locator: Theorem 1.1; Corollaries 1.2 and 1.4; Remarks 1.3 and surrounding conductor-removal discussion

sources.citation: Francesc Castella, On the p-part of the Birch-Swinnerton-Dyer formula for multiplicative primes, arXiv:1704.06608
Xiaojun Yan and Xiuwu Zhu, Main conjectures for non-CM elliptic curves at good ordinary primes, arXiv:2412.20078; J. Algebra 693 (2026)
Timo Keller and Mulun Yin, On the anticyclotomic Iwasawa theory of newforms at Eisenstein primes of semistable reduction, arXiv:2402.12781
sources.locator: abstract-level strong-BSD and p-converse applications; theorem-level extraction required before composition

sources.citation: Li Cai, Chao Li, and Shuai Zhai, On the 2-part of the Birch and Swinnerton-Dyer conjecture for quadratic twists of elliptic curves, arXiv:1712.01271
Jie Shu and Shuai Zhai, Generalized Birch lemma and the 2-part of the Birch and Swinnerton-Dyer conjecture for certain elliptic curves, arXiv:2102.11808

records.name: Non-CM rank-one p-converse without conductor restrictions
records.prime_profile: at least one good ordinary p>3 with E[p] irreducible and Sha[p-infinity] finite
residual_hypotheses: E[p] irreducible at the chosen good ordinary prime
records.selmer_structure: classical p-infinity Selmer group and p-strict local condition
records.normalization: complete complex L(E,s), central point s=1
hypotheses: Sha(E/Q)[p-infinity] finite for one admissible p

records.name: Rank-one p-part at multiplicative primes
records.domain: semistable elliptic curves over Q of analytic rank one
records.prime_profile: p>3 of multiplicative reduction with E[p] irreducible
records.selmer_structure: multiplicative local condition with exceptional-zero correction
records.normalization: complex rank-one BSD quotient with source local factors
records.conclusion: the p-adic valuation identity predicted by the rank-one BSD formula

records.name: Good-ordinary p-converse and p-part in ranks at most one
records.prime_profile: p>2, p not dividing 2N, good ordinary
residual_hypotheses: source image condition for the integral p-part
records.normalization: source p-adic L-functions and complete complex BSD quotient
records.conclusion: Selmer corank r iff complex analytic rank r; under the image condition the p-part BSD formula holds

records.name: Eisenstein-prime strong-BSD interface
records.domain: elliptic curves and weight-two newforms at reducible residual primes
records.prime_profile: p>2 Eisenstein primes under source-specific hypotheses
records.reduction_profile: good and multiplicative branches in the source
residual_hypotheses: reducible residual representation with theorem-specific characters and local hypotheses
records.normalization: source-specific p-adic and complex BSD normalizations
hypotheses: exact theorem and branch must be extracted before use
records.conclusion: source proves p-parts and p-converses in substantial Eisenstein cases; no generic reducible-prime theorem is imported

records.name: Explicit quadratic-twist 2-part families
records.domain: explicit quadratic twist families of elliptic curves over Q
records.rank_range: analytic rank 0 or 1 in specified families
residual_hypotheses: base curve and twist hypotheses from the source
hypotheses: curve belongs to the explicit source family
records.conclusion: the 2-part holds for specified infinite twist families or propagates under the source hypotheses
